test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets and complete the sentence.**

The weather is _____ (gloomy) and windy.
solution: The correct answer is '**cloudy**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**gloomy**' is '**cloudy**'. • **Gloomy**: dark in way that makes you feel sad. (ऐसा गहरा कि उदास कर दे) • *Example: This dark paint makes the room very **gloomy**.* • **Cloudy**: (used about the sky, etc.) full of clouds. [(आकाश) मेघाच्‍छन्‍न; बादलों से ढका] • *Example: cloudy water...* **Correct Answer:__** *cloudy.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **bright**: having a lot of light. (प्रकाश-भरा, प्रदीप्‍त, उज्ज्वल, चमकीला) • **jovial**: (used about a person) happy and friendly. [(व्‍यक्ति) प्रसन्‍न और मित्रवत] • **shiny**: causing a bright effect when in the sun or in light. [चमकदार (धूप या रोशनी में)] 38:T676, The correct answer is** 'guessed that it was an aeroplane'.**
